failures.description: A template catalogue entry named chat was presented as a strong AI chat runtime feature.
failures.expected: Catalogue JSON may be described as metadata but must not establish a runtime feature.
failures.actual: AI chat was reported as a strong feature with two symbols.
failures.root_cause: Feature source signals accepted non-executable JSON catalogue content as runtime behavior evidence.
failures.regression_test: tests/V3FeatureEvidenceTest.php — catalogue JSON named chat cannot create AI chat

failures.description: A completed partial scan was stored as a crash after Windows returned -1 from proc_close.
failures.expected: Use the final proc_get_status exit code and preserve the partial scan result.
failures.actual: The corpus record said failed with an empty crash reason.
failures.root_cause: Alpha child-process orchestration discarded the final non-negative exit code on Windows.

failures.description: Quick analysis exhausted 128 MiB while decoding unbounded TypeScript worker evidence.
failures.expected: Bound worker output, disclose partial evidence, and finish below the memory ceiling.
failures.actual: PHP exhausted memory in NodeWorkerAnalyzerProvider while decoding the worker graph.
failures.root_cause: Node workers emitted unbounded symbol and relationship arrays while PHP retained duplicate input buffers.
failures.regression_test: tests/V3AstTest.php — semantic output is capped before PHP graph decoding

failures.description: Self-dogfood attempted an authentication-gated remote despite an explicitly authorized local repository being available.
failures.expected: Use a static exact-commit archive from the authorized local repository.
failures.actual: Safe Git import failed because terminal authentication was disabled.
failures.root_cause: The initial corpus importer only supported anonymous public HTTPS repositories.
